description: This file defines the UpgraderConfigUtility class, which provides methods for checking the database status and connection for the upgrade process within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with database schema management and handles exceptions related to database connectivity and schema verification.

classes.name: UpgraderConfigUtility
classes.description: Provides utility methods to verify database status and connectivity during the system upgrade process.

methods.name: checkDatabaseStatus
methods.description: Checks if the 'ohrm_upgrade_status' table exists in the database, indicating the current upgrade status.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a Doctrine DBAL connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Gets the schema manager from the current database connection, which allows schema introspection.

methods.name: checkDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Verifies the database connection, throwing an exception if there is an error or if the database is in an upgrade-interrupted state.
